item.title: Economy grows by 7.8% in Q3 of FY26 as per new GDP series: Govt data
item.description: NEW DELHI: India’s economy grew by 7.8 per cent during the October-December quarter of 2025-26, up from 7.4 per cent a year ago, according to the new series of national accounts with 2022-23 as the base year.
